content.text: Let me compute the 6-month discontinuation rate using OMOP CDM conventions: new-user cohort (first SSRI fill with no prior history), followed for 6 months. "Discontinuation" = no continuation of any SSRI within 30 days of their supply expiry over that 6-month window.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Step 1: New-user cohort — first SSRI fill, with a 365-day washout (no prior SSRI use)
-- SSRI drugs: fluoxetine(755695), sertraline(739138), citalopram(797617), paroxetine(722031), escitalopram(715939), fluvoxamine(751412)
WITH ssri_list AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept 
  WHERE standard_concept = 'S' AND domain_id = 'Drug' 
    AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
),
first_fill AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  -- include all SSRI concepts by name match as a broad net
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ssri_list sl 
    INNER JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = sl.concept_id
    INNER JOIN omop.ancestor_concept ac ON ac.descendant_concept_id = sl.concept_id
    WHERE c.concept_name IN ('fluoxetine','sertraline','citalopram','escitalopram','paroxetine','fluvoxamine')
  )
  GROUP BY de.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS new_users, CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2), AVG(index_date)) OVER () 
FROM first_fill;
